articles.title: Experts Ask the Government to Explain What 'Ultraprocessed' Food Means
articles.summary: More than 100 experts urged the government to release its first official definition of ultraprocessed foods, a step proposed in August but not yet released.

articles.title: Plane Fuel Costs More Than Ever, and Holiday Flights Cost More Too
articles.summary: Jet fuel prices hit a record high, pushing Thanksgiving airfares up about 30%. Travelers are still booking, but some families are choosing to drive instead.

articles.title: Extra Watchers Will Be on Duty at Polling Places on Election Day
articles.summary: The Justice Department plans to send about 1,000 election monitors to polling places in all 50 states on November 3. Supporters say the watchers protect voting rights; some officials worry the bigger effort, and the use of prosecutors, could scare voters.
